title: Astray: Zero
description:
A 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game.

In the game, players need to continuously defeat monsters and progress to the next level.All you do is keep fighting!

The character is fully equipped with abilities right from the start: attack, jump, dash, and bullet time.

Players have 5 health bars, and each time they take damage, hallucinations intensify, leaving afterimages along the character's movement path.

 

Main features:

- 11 richly detailed hand-painted scenes

- Cute yet cool female protagonist, Zero, with 9 different character actions

- 8 enemies, each with unique behaviors

- Unlimited use of bullet time, allowing precise control of every moment- Original, dynamic BGM and sound effects

- Low difficulty, instantly respawn at the current level after death
